title: Your Attention Span Is Being Trained Against You
description:
The average person switches tasks every few seconds. That is not a flaw in you. It is a response to an environment built to interrupt.

Made with AI assistance.

#facts #science #psychology #education #learn

scenes.narration: The average person switches tasks every few seconds. That is not a flaw in you. It is a response to an environment built to interrupt.
Every notification is a small prediction error. Your brain drops what it is doing to check, because historically an unexpected sound mattered.
The cost is not the interruption itself. It is the recovery time. Refocusing can take far longer than the interruption lasted.
Multitasking is mostly rapid switching, and every switch leaves a residue of the previous task in your working memory.
Deep work requires a boring environment. The people who focus best are not disciplined. They removed the choice.
Try twenty five minutes with the phone in another room. Not silent. Another room. Distance beats willpower every time.
